tests.justification: Tests nested parentheses with addition and multiplication, ensuring correct precedence and left-to-right evaluation for operators of equal precedence.
Tests deeply nested parentheses with subtraction and multiplication, verifying correct handling of nested subexpressions and operator precedence.

rationale: The requirement explicitly mandates support for nested parentheses. These tests cover both simple and complex nesting scenarios to validate that the calculator correctly evaluates expressions with multiple layers of parentheses, respecting standard precedence and left-to-right evaluation for equal-precedence operators.
